meta.title: Tokens: ~15-min access, refresh rotates, reuse revokes the family, refresh stored hashed
meta.requirement: AC9 — token lifetimes, rotation, reuse, hashing
steps: Sign up; decode the access token's exp − iat
Query the DB for the raw token
expected: Access lifetime 900 s (exp − iat) and expiresIn 900 — API response
Refresh with R1 returns a new pair with a different refresh token — API response
Reusing R1 → 401 REFRESH_REUSED, then R2 is refused too (family revoked) — API response
DB holds no row whose token_hash equals the raw refresh token — DB

3.observed: reuse→401 REFRESH_REUSED, new token after reuse→401 REFRESH_INVALID
